Positive supply-support thesis: the company reported near-full production, H1 average shipments above 10 million sheets per month, Shaoguan 70,000-tonne yarn capacity commencing at end-June, and 95 million metres of cloth capacity due for full production in Q3. Source: Kingboard Laminates 2026 interim announcement, published 2026-08-24. The factor range is an AI-proposed assumption confirmed by the collaborator in this conversation; major CCL and copper-foil expansion starts in 2027, so the 2026 volume assumption remains restrained.

Positive pricing thesis: the company reported multiple price rises in H1, acceleration in Q2, and H2 prices continuing to soar, but disclosed no ASP or rise percentage. Source: Kingboard Laminates 2026 interim announcement, published 2026-08-24. The factor range is an AI-proposed assumption confirmed by the collaborator in this conversation. July profit of about HKD1.1 billion has unclear accounting basis and is background only, never a formula input.

Cost-mitigation thesis: the company reported that vertical integration maintained near-full production and delivery amid peers' glass-fibre-cloth shortages. Source: Kingboard Laminates 2026 interim announcement, published 2026-08-24. The factor range is an AI-proposed assumption confirmed by the collaborator in this conversation.

H1 disclosed an equity-instrument fair-value loss of HKD 269,242,000; the direction of H2 fair-value movement is unpredictable and this distribution is not company guidance. Source: Kingboard Laminates 2026 interim announcement, published 2026-08-24. The zero-centred distribution is an AI-proposed assumption confirmed by the collaborator in this conversation.

Financing-cost-up thesis: the company reported net gearing of approximately 30% at 30 June 2026 versus approximately 16% at 31 December 2025. Source: Kingboard Laminates 2026 interim announcement, published 2026-08-24. The factor range is an AI-proposed assumption confirmed by the collaborator in this conversation.
